---
name: Metric dispute
about: necessary_tokens for a task is too high or too low
title: "denominator: <task id>"
labels: metric
---

The denominator is the product, so this is the most useful issue you can open.

- Task:
- The committed `necessary_tokens`:
- What it should be:
- Why the task still gets solved with fewer (or more) steps:
- The step list you would change in `tasks/<id>/reference/trajectory.json`:
